title: Brazilian Beef Skewers with Mustard Sauce
description: Tender beef skewers marinated in a zesty Brazilian-inspired sauce, grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of tangy mustard sauce for dipping.

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.amount: 1 pound (450g) beef sirloin, cut into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.amount: 10 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes

ingredients.name: nifty
ingredients.amount: 2 cloves nifty (such as garlic or onion), minced

ingredients.name: brazilian
ingredients.amount: 2 tablespoons (30g) Brazilian-style seasoning (such as malagueta pepper, cumin, and coriander)

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together mustard, nifty, and brazilian seasoning.
Add the beef cubes to the marinade and toss to coat.
Thread the marinated beef onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (400°F/200°C).
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, mix together the remaining marinade and a little water to create a dipping sauce.
Serve the skewers with the mustard sauce for dipping.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
